title: What's new
intro: PlayRPG release history. The newest version is at the top.

scene.scenes: Several scenes per game; the GM moves the party from one to the next.
scene.grid: A grid with your own cell size, distance units and snapping.
scene.tools: Select, ruler and drawing for everyone, plus fog of war for the GM.
scene.tokens: Character and image tokens: move, box-select, rotate, resize and duplicate.
scene.overlays: Health, condition slots and bars right on the token, and tokens hidden from players.
scene.controls: Ping the map, pan with the right mouse button and pick the control scheme that suits you.
scene.combat: Turn order tracker per scene: initiative, rounds, hidden participants and an end-turn button for players.

characters.sheet: A character sheet for every system, in a popup or in its own browser tab.
characters.manage: Create, edit, clone and delete characters; the GM decides which players see each one.
characters.conditions: Conditions such as bleeding or stunned, and marking a character as dead.
characters.rolls: Roll characteristics, skills and weapons straight from the sheet, with modifiers.
characters.favourites: Favourite skills and weapons at hand in the character panel.

creator.fields: Build your own sheet from sections and many field types:attributes, tables, bars, formula fields, skill trees and more.
creator.dice: Your own roll rules: dice under the chat, a numeric modifier or edge and setback dice, and success levels per step or named thresholds.
creator.presets: Preset weapons and rows added to every new character.
creator.token: Token look for your system: slots and bars shown on the map.
creator.sharing: Describe a template, share it with other users, clone it and sync changes into a running game.
creator.preview: Preview a template's sheet before you pick it for a game.

dice.chat: Chat with a roll log and the /roll (/r), /gmroll (/gmr) and /help commands.
dice.visibility: Choose who sees a roll: everyone, the GM and you, the GM only, or one player.
dice.myRolls: Show only your own rolls in the log.
dice.animation: Rolls land on the scene as 3D dice in the roller's colour, with sound. Turn them off in the game's General tab or in your account settings.

materials.handouts: Handouts in folders, shared with everyone or with chosen players.
materials.files: An image library with folders for the GM.
materials.music: A music library and playlists played for the whole party, with looping and your own volume.
materials.notes: Private and public notes with text formatting.

games.lobby: A game list; create a game for the system of your choice, filtered by language.
games.lobbyFilter: Search the game list by game or system name; if you both run and play games, show only one kind with a click.
games.players: Invite players, remove them or leave a game.
games.inviteLink: Invite link: the GM copies one link and pastes it on Discord; whoever opens it joins the game, even if they still have to register first.
games.participant: Your avatar and name in each game: from your account, from your character or your own.
games.colors: Every player has their own colour in each game: on their avatar, rulers, pings, drawings and log entries. Pick any colour in your player settings.
games.themes: Game themes: the GM picks the look of the table — Parchment, Sci-fi, 1920s or Dark fantasy — with its own colours, fonts and window frames. A player can stay on Parchment for themselves.

systems.builtIn: Ready-made sheets for Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 4e, Call of Cthulhu 7e, Call of Cthulhu: Dark Ages and SRD 5.2.
systems.custom: Any other system you build in the system creator.

minigames.dice: Yahtzee and dice poker to play with the party between scenes.

tutorials.tours: Interactive tutorials: the question mark next to a tab header walks you through the screen.
tutorials.help: Help pages: the full user guide inside the app under Help, linked from the tutorials.
tutorials.links: A footer on every page with the terms, privacy policy, licenses, contact, what's new and help. In a game, the guide and what's new sit next to the tutorial question mark, and the bottom of the General tab lists all of these links.

accounts.register: An account with email verification and a reset for a forgotten password.
accounts.profile: A username and an avatar with built-in cropping.
accounts.stats: Your statistics: dice rolls and time spent online.
accounts.language: The interface in English and Polish.
accounts.legal: Cookie consent, privacy policy, terms of service and licenses.
accounts.contact: A Contact page with a form: report a bug or send feedback, report illegal or rule-breaking content (no account needed) and other messages.

site.fonts: Fonts are served by PlayRPG itself; opening the site sends nothing to Google before you agree to statistics.
site.linkPreview: Links to PlayRPG shared in messengers and on social media show a preview card with the logo.
site.pageTitles: Every page names its browser tab, and a game tab shows the game's name.

changed.privacy: A fuller privacy policy: what data we store on the server, who processes it for us, how long we keep it, the legal bases and your rights under the GDPR.
changed.navigation: The top bar labels its buttons. Settings and Logout sit in the menu under your email button, legal pages are in the footer, and on a phone every link is under one menu button.
changed.panelHints: The help, What's new and tutorial icons in the game panel header show their name as soon as you point at them.

fixed.language: The game room speaks one language: log messages, button hints, the first scene name and error messages follow the chosen interface language.
